boundary_note: Every entry is a proposed acceptance contract, not evidence that a component has been built, funded, approved, or operated.

components.spatial_anchor: heritage green spine / public node edge
components.user_group: older adults, disabled users, carers, and ordinary walkers
components.minimum_data_and_retention: consented comfort and accessibility observations; retain only the aggregate review period
components.human_takeover: staff can provide directions, shade, rest, and a non-digital route without data collection
components.maintenance_record: inspection date, shade and seat condition, repair owner, repair close-out
components.positive_evidence: continuous usable rest, fewer reported heat/accessibility breaks, and clear human-help response
components.negative_evidence: unsafe surface, unusable shade, inaccessible approach, repeated unanswered help request
components.stop_retirement_decision: close or relocate when the component is unsafe, unmaintainable, or worsens access; publish the reason
components.opening_gate: consented accessibility and heat-safety walk plus basic maintenance responsibility

components.spatial_anchor: model and scenario entry points along the version line
components.user_group: residents, visitors, students, operators, and reviewers
components.minimum_data_and_retention: source, version, date, confidence, change note; no identity tracking
components.human_takeover: a person can answer questions and provide a printed or static explanation
components.maintenance_record: source freshness, change review, correction, and withdrawal log
components.positive_evidence: a visitor can identify source, date, uncertainty, and how to challenge a claim
components.negative_evidence: stale source, unexplained change, inaccessible text, or no correction route
components.stop_retirement_decision: hide or revert the marker when the underlying source cannot be verified or the notice is misleading
components.opening_gate: source and version register reviewed by a named maintainer

components.user_group: disabled users, carers, non-digital users, and people seeking help
components.minimum_data_and_retention: opt-in task request and aggregate outcome only; no route history by default
components.human_takeover: phone, in-person, and physical wayfinding remain available at all times
components.maintenance_record: opening hours, staff handoff, accessibility check, complaint and resolution record
components.positive_evidence: users complete or recover a route with an understandable choice of AI and human help
components.negative_evidence: AI-only barrier, unexplained recommendation, missed handoff, or loss of basic service after opt-out
components.stop_retirement_decision: disable AI guidance and retain the physical service when safety, fairness, or explanation fails
components.opening_gate: human fallback, consent language, and accessibility review signed before trial

components.spatial_anchor: Zhongzhiyuan low-speed loop, observation edge, and handoff window
components.user_group: test teams, independent reviewers, nearby workers, and observing public
components.minimum_data_and_retention: scenario version, speed/time boundary, intervention, incident, and re-test record
components.human_takeover: physical stop, trained marshal, safe waiting area, and network-failure procedure
components.maintenance_record: barrier, signage, stop-control, equipment, and incident-response inspection
components.positive_evidence: reproducible run, successful handoff, clear public separation, and complete incident-free or incident record
components.negative_evidence: near miss, boundary breach, lost stop control, untrained operator, or irreproducible result
components.stop_retirement_decision: return to simulation and close the field window after a critical failure until an independent re-test passes
components.opening_gate: permission, risk assessment, physical separation, trained operator, and emergency drill

components.spatial_anchor: AI Origin Community and Dazhongsi service corridor
components.user_group: residents, merchants, students, visitors, and service staff
components.minimum_data_and_retention: purpose, model version, limitation, appeal route, and minimal task record
components.human_takeover: staff can explain, correct, or refuse the algorithmic suggestion
components.maintenance_record: model-card freshness, notice legibility, complaint, appeal, and correction log
components.positive_evidence: people can understand what the system does, what it cannot do, and how to challenge it
components.negative_evidence: opaque notice, stale limitation, discriminatory service effect, or unanswerable appeal
components.stop_retirement_decision: withdraw the algorithmic service and keep the ordinary service when explanation or fairness cannot be restored
components.opening_gate: model card, public notice, human owner, complaint route, and sunset date

components.spatial_anchor: submission wall, city-model museum, and public contribution nodes
components.user_group: students, developers, residents, reviewers, and contributors
components.minimum_data_and_retention: opt-in contribution, license, version, review state, and withdrawal record
components.human_takeover: curator can correct, anonymize, reject, or remove a contribution
components.maintenance_record: license review, attribution correction, retraction, accessibility and display inspection
components.positive_evidence: a contribution can be reproduced, attributed with consent, challenged, and withdrawn
components.negative_evidence: unclear rights, accidental identity exposure, uncorrected error, or inaccessible display
components.stop_retirement_decision: remove or quarantine the contribution when rights, privacy, accuracy, or public harm cannot be resolved
components.opening_gate: license and consent check, review state, public correction route, and display accessibility
